Hey everyone!

We're a married couple (Israeli and Greek) ,and currently we're waiting for our branch (Rehovot) to schedule our appointment.

We had a walk in to check the status of our application, and the clerk said that when we'll present the documents I might not receive the B1 visa on spot, but they might need further investigation for our application. When we mentioned that according to the PIBA instructions the visa should be issued the day we present our documents the clerk claimed that each case is different and there's is no standard protocol.

Is this legal? How should we proceed in case I won't receive my visa during the scheduled appointment?

Thanks a lot for all the answers and the help.
